long_biography.plain_text:
Jim Hauslein helped turn Sunglass Hut from a regional chain into an international seller of sunglasses and watches. Trained in chemical engineering and business at Cornell, he entered the company through a private-equity acquisition and later bought out other investors and its founders. As chairman, he oversaw new stores and acquisitions, and broadened selling through catalogues and early websites. Luxottica eventually acquired the business.

He subsequently led a recapitalisation of workwear supplier Big Time Products with its founders and institutional investors. He served as its executive chairman and, for a period, chief executive before another company acquired it. Away from investment work, Hauslein became a seasoned pilot and served on the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association's board, including a term as chairman.

Trained in chemical engineering and business at Cornell, he entered the company through a private-equity acquisition and later bought out other investors and its founders. As chairman, he oversaw new stores and acquisitions, and broadened selling through catalogues and early websites. Luxottica eventually acquired the business.

He subsequently led a recapitalisation of workwear supplier Big Time Products with its founders and institutional investors. He served as its executive chairman and, for a period, chief executive before another company acquired it. Away from investment work, Hauslein became a seasoned pilot and served on the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association's board, including a term as chairman.
